name: Freenet Chat Roulette
summary: Decentralized stranger video chat: lobby monoid matchmaking, 1:1 sessions, WebRTC P2P media, friends and party-of-two browse.
description: Chat Roulette for Freenet. Mutual-claim lobby matching (no central queue), per-match session contracts for chat and WebRTC signaling, and peer-to-peer camera/mic. Includes a simple WebSocket bridge for demos and a Freenet agent/contracts path for on-network matchmaking.

atlas.title: Freenet Chat Roulette
atlas.one_liner: Stranger video chat with monoid lobby matching and P2P WebRTC
